purpose: Teach: 内的/醸成/顕在/利己/襲う/疑わしい/粉砕/萎縮

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の内的な動機を警察、解明されてますね
lines.en: So the police have clarified the suspect's internal motivations in this case, haven't they?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity with a thread of genuine respect. Measured pace. Leans forward slightly. The cadence of someone thinking while speaking, not reciting.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯意識を醸成する活動を続けます
lines.en: The police will continue our community crime prevention awareness efforts.
lines.style: Steady, formal but not cold. Clear emphasis on 'continue'—this is ongoing work, not a one-time response. Shoulders relaxed. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑が顕在化する前の予兆を警察、警戒されてますね
lines.en: And the police are being vigilant for warning signs before suspicions even surface, correct?
lines.style: Lean slightly inward. Gentle but probing. The tone of someone who notices details others miss. Unhurried. The question mark is soft—genuine inquiry, not challenge.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、利己的な犯行動機にも対応します
lines.en: The police respond to selfish criminal motives with the same care and attention.
lines.style: Even-toned, matter-of-fact. Professional confidence without arrogance. Slight pause before 'selfish'—acknowledging the weight of the word. No apology in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、市民を襲う事件への警戒を強化されてますね、警察
lines.en: The police are intensifying their vigilance against incidents that target citizens, isn't that so?
lines.style: Respectful persistence. The pace quickens slightly, showing engagement rather than passivity. Hands steady. Voice carries genuine concern beneath the formal observation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、疑わしい人物を慎重に調査します
lines.en: We investigate suspicious individuals carefully and thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet authority. The word 'carefully' gets a gentle weight—this is principle, not procedure. Breath steady. No expansion needed; the words carry themselves.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場の岩を粉砕する作業も警察、立ち会われますね
lines.en: So the police will also be present at the site for the work to process the rock evidence?
lines.style: Logical curiosity, following a thread. Level tone. Slightly faster than before—the mind working through implications. Not anxious, just engaged in understanding the full scope.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の心が萎縮しないよう配慮します
lines.en: We take care to ensure the victims' trust and sense of safety aren't diminished.
lines.style: Softens noticeably here. This is the heart of the work. Slower pace. The word 'trust' lands with quiet conviction. A small breath at the end—this matters.
